_note: Fictional demo airport. Ridgeline Regional (KXRG) does not exist; these facts are invented to resemble a small non-towered mountain field. Live weather on the public site comes from a real stand-in station (see public-site/src/lib/aviation.ts).
name: Ridgeline Regional Airport

runways.lighting: MIRL (medium intensity edge lights), REIL both ends, PAPI both ends

notes: Cold temperature airport - altitude correction required at or below -15C.
Wildlife on and in the vicinity of the airport.
